findings.title: Crowd Control players still get success while people remain inside — the new count excludes knocked-down people, and the documented standalone copy still drops asked people immediately
findings.observed: A knocked-down person is excluded; the standalone copy also excludes anyone just asked to move.

findings.title: Players still see incorrect three-star targets — day-scaled thresholds are rounded only for display, and the documented standalone copy retains the original Yulu and Recovery mismatch
findings.observed: Day 2 Recovery shows 1:59 but judges 118.75s; standalone day 1 Yulu shows 1:15 vs 1:02.

findings.title: Players of the documented standalone game can still move under the mission-failed card after collapsing — its crash callback still resumes after opening the failure sheet
findings.observed: In the standalone game, dismissing the crash card resumes movement under Mission failed.

findings.title: Players opening the documented standalone game cannot freely drive unlocked vehicles or take road traffic — the vehicle changes were applied only to index.html
findings.observed: Standalone Vehicles still cost ₹500–₹40,000 and moving traffic cannot be entered.

findings.title: Players keep hearing the stand-in for a cloned line after a temporary connection error — voxClip permanently caches each pre-start audio error as unavailable
findings.observed: One pre-start media error marks that line unavailable until reload, even after recovery.

findings.title: Players can lose or stall Adhiraj’s next line when skipping dialogue during a slow load — an old play rejection calls off on the reused audio element before checking its token
findings.observed: A cancelled old play promise can pause and detach the next clip's handlers.

findings.title: Crowd Control can finish with someone back inside the circle — the out flag permanently excludes an asked person instead of recounting their current position
findings.observed: An asked person marked out is ignored if they walk back into the circle.

findings.title: Crowd Control players see remaining people after they have walked outside the marked circle — the count adds 12 units to the drawn radius
findings.observed: A person at 110 units is counted inside the drawn 105-unit circle.

findings.title: Crowd Control can declare the circle empty while a bystander is inside — the count checks only the preselected m.crowd instead of everyone currently in the circle
findings.observed: Non-selected NPCs walking into the circle do not increase the displayed count.

findings.title: Players miss the rest of Adhiraj’s sentence when a voice recording fails after playback starts — the new error branch advances directly instead of completing the line
findings.observed: A mid-line audio error skips the remaining words and advances to the next segment.

findings.title: Players cannot find their active mission on the full campus map — the updated marker loop excludes MX.cur and never draws its objective separately
findings.observed: Opening the campus map during Yulu omits the active Yulu marker entirely.

findings.title: Phone players still cannot read overlapping daily mission names on the campus map — the changed marker loop draws fixed-size labels without collision handling
findings.observed: Nearby mission labels can overlap because their fixed boxes are drawn without spacing.

findings.title: All-Nighter players can win after running out of energy at the finish — the mission awards success at 04:00 before the collapse check runs
findings.observed: At 04:00 with energy drained to 0, All-Nighter awards 1★ instead of failing.

findings.title: Standalone players still see the old campus and panels — the realism pass was added only to index.html
findings.observed: The documented standalone game has neither the realism panel styles nor the campus bake.

findings.title: Players trying to re-enter a parked vehicle can be offered a farther traffic vehicle instead — traffic is always prioritized before comparing parked-vehicle distance
findings.observed: A moving car 55 units away wins over a parked car immediately beside the player.

findings.title: Players cannot see that the unlocked vehicles cost ₹0 in the store — owned rows replace the price with the Owned label
findings.observed: Vehicle rows say Owned but do not display the requested ₹0 price.
